prompt:
Protect the API with keys and roles.
- Requests carry `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys live in the data as `apiKeys: [{ "key", "name", "role" }]`; add one key per role to data/seed.json.
- Roles: `viewer` may only read (GET). `cook` may also cook recipes, record waste, log temperatures and enter stock-take counts. `manager` may do everything.
- A request without a key or with an unknown key is 401; a known key without permission is 403. Both answer in the usual error shape with their own error codes.
- Every request that changes data writes an audit entry (time, key name, method, path, status). `GET /audit` lists them newest first and is for managers only.
Update the existing tests so they send a key.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: The API now needs a Bearer key with a viewer, cook or manager role. A missing or unknown key gets 401 `unauthorized`, and a key without the permission gets 403 `forbidden`. Every non-GET request made with a known key writes an audit entry, including requests that fail; requests that get a 401 are not logged. `GET /audit` lists the entries newest first, for managers only. `npm test` (26 pass) and `npm run lint` pass, and I checked the 401/403/audit cases with a one-off script. Choices to review: (1) I did not add any automated tests for the new auth and audit behaviour, only updated the existing ones to send a key. (2) Only `data/seed.json` got keys. `data/db.json`, which `npm start` uses, has none, so the server will refuse every request until you add keys there. (3) I added `apiKeys`/`audit` the same way earlier collections like `outbox` were added, without raising the schema version; a file with no keys lets no request in. (4) The seed keys are placeholders such as `seed-manager-key-change-me`. Replace them before real use.

check.why: keys, roles, audit and docs all right
